newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Akzo opens Rotterdam metal alkyls plant.
newsitem.headline: Akzo opens Rotterdam metal alkyls plant.

text.p: Dutch chemicals group Akzo Nobel said on Thursday it had inaugurated a new metal alkyls production facility in Rotterdam.
The new plant will primarily serve European and Middle Eastern customers, it said, reinforcing the group's capacity in the growing metal alkyls market.
The Rotterdam plant will produce tri-ethylaluminium, di-ethylaluminium chloride and ethylaluminium sesquichloride. It has integral blending, storage and loading facilities.
"Rotterdam was selected due to a combination of strategic location and short supply lines for key raw materials including ethylene and hydrogen," said Akzo board member Rudy van der Meer.
With the opening of the new plant, Akzo now produces metal alkyls in North America, Europe, Brazil and in Japan.
